content.intro: This lesson introduces introduction to software testing in python as part of testing, debugging, and code quality. It turns the curriculum heading into a short, practical concept guide with a visual, example, and checks to try locally.
content.why_it_matters: Reliable software expects mistakes and failures. Reproduce the smallest failing case, assert the intended behavior, and fix the cause rather than hiding the symptom.
